Reviewed current diff and URL transport call paths. Existing tests executed: `python -m pytest -q test/units/module_utils/urls test/units/plugins/lookup/test_url.py` -> 134 passed, 4 warnings (Python 3.11.13). Code defect: when HAS_SSLCONTEXT is false and PyOpenSSLContext is available, Request.open creates the configured context but HTTPSClientAuthHandler (used for client_cert or unix_socket) is constructed without it at urls.py:1523-1527. Its _build_https_connection at urls.py:603-617 uses self._context, never the configured PyOpenSSL context. urllib opener orders HTTPSClientAuthHandler ahead of CustomHTTPSHandler, so these requests do not negotiate specified ciphers. Correct by carrying the same context into the selected handler/connection for the fallback path. No test environment problem for executed tests; fallback PyOpenSSL package is unavailable locally, so that specific path could not be exercised with its real implementation.
